traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for 007.0-DEV-ERROR-REPORTING are fully implemented and verified. Each core validation rule (require-story-annotation, require-req-annotation, require-branch-annotation, valid-annotation-format, valid-story-reference, valid-req-reference) uses structured ESLint `meta.messages` with specific placeholders, provides clear and actionable error text, and, where appropriate, auto-fixes or suggestions. Rule-specific and cross-rule conventions (function name placeholders, branch `{{missing}}`, `Invalid annotation format: {{details}}.`, and file/requirement path placeholders) are implemented and exhaustively tested. Error severity mapping (errors vs warnings) matches the story’s specification and is enforced via plugin configs, with tests confirming recommended/strict presets. Edge cases and error conditions (missing context, invalid configuration, filesystem errors) are handled gracefully with dedicated diagnostics and without throwing. Comprehensive tests explicitly reference this story and its requirements and all pass, so the story is assessed as PASSED.
